verdict.rationale: The docs describe a publish/subscribe media model: each attendee publishes one video source (up to 25 per meeting), and constrained clients automatically subscribe to a lower-bitrate stream. That implies server-side selective forwarding of the streams each client subscribes to, but the pack never explicitly names an SFU or relay architecture. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of SFU/relay media routing, documented per-participant track subscription controls (choosing which remote tracks to receive), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, media routes through a selective forwarding unit or relay that delivers only the tracks each participant subscribes to

citations.quote: Clients with bandwidth constraints automatically subscribe to the lower bitrate stream.
Each attendee can publish one video source, up to a total of 25 simultaneous videos per meeting.
